boolean AND.

repo with an ordinary foreign hook and no git anywhere on PATH must
PASS "not enabled here", deliberately without the exec.LookPath("git")
skip other execution-path tests use, since the point is that this case
must pass even when execution could not have run at all.
EOF

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

func main() {
	parent, _ := os.MkdirTemp("", "walktest")
	dir := filepath.Join(parent, "sandbox")
	locked := filepath.Join(dir, "locked")
	os.MkdirAll(locked, 0o755)
	os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(locked, "file"), []byte("x"), 0o644)
	os.Chmod(locked, 0o000)

	err := os.RemoveAll(dir)
	fmt.Println("bare RemoveAll:", err)

	err = filepath.Walk(dir, func(p string, info os.FileInfo, walkErr error) error {
		fmt.Println("walk:", p, walkErr)
		if walkErr == nil {
			ce := os.Chmod(p, 0o700)
			fmt.Println("  chmod:", ce)
		}
		return nil
	})
	fmt.Println("walk err:", err)

	err = os.RemoveAll(dir)
	fmt.Println("retry RemoveAll:", err)
	os.RemoveAll(parent)
}
EOF
